title: Burr–Erdős conjecture on Ramsey numbers of trees
statement:
Let $T$ be a tree on $n$ vertices. **Burr–Erdős conjecture.**

$$
R(T,T) \leq 2n-2
$$

when $n$ is even, and

$$
R(T,T) \leq 2n-3
$$

otherwise.

This is a central conjecture in the study of Ramsey numbers of trees; the source presents it as a major conjecture without giving evidence of its resolution.
source_name: Yair Caro and Xandru Mifsud, “On zero-sum Ramsey numbers modulo 3”, arXiv:2502.03864 (2026).
references:
Source: https://arxiv.org/abs/2502.03864

Status: **open** according to the source (as of February 2025). “Amongst the many open problems remaining concerning trees, we mention the following conjecture.”
